caption: The drawing features a single wooden chair centered on a plain, beige background. The chair is depicted at a three-quarter angle, showing both the front and the right side. It has a slightly curved, rectangular backrest supported by five vertical spindles. The seat is flat with visible woodgrain texture and appears slightly contoured from use. The legs of the chair are angled outward and reinforced by horizontal stretchers on both the sides and the front. The color of the chair is a dark, almost black tone, contrasting with the lighter background. The drawing appears to be highly detailed, focusing on the wood texture and the reflections on the chair's surface. There are no other objects present in the composition.
title: Kitchen Chair
